# Scholar-verified fixtures

This directory intentionally contains no inheritance case yet.

A case may be added only after its expected shares, blocked heirs, applied rule
IDs, and kitab citations have been reviewed by a qualified Shafi‘i fara’id
scholar. It must validate against `scholar-approved-case.schema.json` and use
the fixture category `SCHOLAR_VERIFIED_TEST`.

The reviewer and review date identify review of both the cited passages and the
expected executable result. A technical test passing is not a substitute for
that review.
